title: Chroma
tagline: Red and green make yellow. Yellow and blue make trouble.
description: A merge game where the merges follow light rather than arithmetic. Tiles that share no colour combine into their mixture — red and green into yellow, yellow and blue into white — and two whites collapse into a prism that takes a whole row with it. Because mixing is a branching graph rather than a doubling ladder, there is rarely one correct move: cash the yellows in now, or hold the blues for something better. Everyone gets the same tile order each day.
author: HexCave
howToPlay: Tap or click a column to drop the tile shown at the top. On a keyboard, keys 1 to 6 pick the column.
Two tiles touching side by side or one above the other merge if they share no colour: red and green become yellow, red and blue become magenta, yellow and blue become white.
Two tiles of the same colour never merge, so a board of nothing but red is a board in trouble.
Two whites side by side collapse into a prism, which clears its entire row.
Every merge drops what is above it, which can set off another merge — chains multiply the score.
Fill every column and the game ends. The daily board gives everyone the same tile order; endless is a fresh sequence every time.
goal: Score as much as you can before the grid fills. Chains are where the points are — a merge that triggers another is worth far more than two separate ones.
